def state(obs):
    return dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'], obs.meta['proprio']['now']))

def move_tcp(target, grip, name, speed=0.4, settle=30):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],include_depth=False)
    p=state(obs); tcp=np.array([p['tcp_'+a] for a in 'xyz'])
    delta=np.array(target)-tcp
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta))/(0.01*speed))))
    actions=np.zeros((n+settle,4),dtype=np.float64)
    actions[:n,:3]=delta/(n*.01)
    actions[:,3]=grip
    obs=r.submit('ee_delta',actions,dt=r.spec()['control_dt'],cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='both',note=name)
    save(obs,name)
    print('TCP',np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:4]))
    return obs
PY
